data.summary: When you pick this model to shoot in your Shooting phase, you may pay 1 Pain token so that this model becomes Empowered. While it is Empowered, its ranged attacks gain **[[SUSTAINED HITS 2]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)** against **VEHICLE** units and **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)** against non-**VEHICLE** units.
